answer: Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. By the summit of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
